meta.title: GATE DA 2027 AIR-100 desk
meta.pattern: 65 questions, 100 marks, 3 hours. GA 15 + DA 85. MCQ penalty 1/3 or 2/3. MSQ and NAT: no penalty, no partial credit. Organising institute for GATE 2027: IIT Madras.
meta.note: Original pattern questions. Official PYQ wording is not reproduced, so nothing is labelled as a verbatim PYQ. Topic-test slots reuse the subject banks; the inventory separates unique items from test slots. A mock score is not a rank prediction.

questions.stem: A fair six-faced die is rolled once. Let X be the number shown. The expected value E[X] is ______ .
questions.sol: E[X] = sum x P(X=x) = 7/2.

A fraud class has prior 1/10. An alert fires with probability 4/5 on fraud and 1/5 on a genuine case. Given an alert, P(fraud | alert) equals ______ .

questions.sol: Predictive value needs prevalence (base rate). Sensitivity and specificity are likelihoods, not posteriors.
